what: Cube button — on hover it rolls 180° on the x axis and the back face stands up (.6s cubic-bezier(.26,.37,.08,1), returning to 0° on the same curve on release). Meanwhile the panel tilts up to 20° toward the cursor (horizontal and vertical), is pulled in by .05 of the cursor distance and floats up 15px, following .04 of the remaining distance each frame. On release, the tilt and pull wobble back into place with 3s elastic.out.

options.pull: Share pulled toward the cursor, default .05
options.return: Time to return to place when released (s), default 3
options.[data-fx-part=front]·[data-fx-part=back]: Front and back — placed as siblings under the same parent (panel). Panel and button sizes are set in the using side’s css

use: Online storeOnline store
note: The original applies move and tilt separately to the plate’s outer frame (.cube-wrap), but the part combines them on a single plate in the order outer-frame share (×.2) → depth → roll to get the same shape.

from.where: shared.js cube button (header Online store) and about.js video box — original linkCube and buttonCube (rx 0→180 .6s cube-hover-in) + Vc (powerX/Y .05, powerZ 1.5 × z 10, powerRX/RY 20, speed .04, returnDuration 3, returnEase Elastic.easeOut)
